name: MD-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Sarah Elfreth running with a large fundraising edge
Prediction markets price Democratic win around 95%
model.rationale: The fundamentals point overwhelmingly to Elfreth: a D+12 district, incumbency, and a fundraising advantage of roughly $1.1 million to $12,700. Markets price her win at about 95%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: Any unexpected polling showing a single-digit race, or major outside spending for Flowers, would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Maryland's 3rd District leans strongly Democratic, and first-term incumbent Sarah Elfreth is seeking re-election with the advantages that typically come with the seat. She has raised about $1.1 million and holds over $330,000 in cash, while Republican Berney Flowers has raised roughly $12,700 with minimal cash on hand and no visible outside support.

No general-election polls or expert ratings are available, so the picture rests on fundamentals and market pricing. Polymarket puts the Democratic win probability near 95%. With the incumbent well-funded in a favorable district and the challenger essentially unfunded, this race sits firmly in Safe D territory.
